messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Talk to your doctor if the pain you have increases.
Talk to your doctor if you feel more sensitive to pain.
Talk to your doctor if you have new pain after taking tramadol.
Tramadol extended-release capsules and tablets may complicate a healthcare provider’s clinical assessment of an acute abdominal condition.
They are not recommended for people with severe liver or severe kidney impairment.
Taking tramadol during pregnancy may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in the newborn.
These symptoms are known as neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome (NOWS).
Some people are "ultra-rapid metabolizers" of tramadol.
This is because of a variation in an enzyme.
The enzyme is called CYP2D6.
People's bodies convert tramadol into tramadol's active form faster than usual.
This can produce dangerously high opioid levels.
This can occur even at a normal dose.
Life-threatening breathing problems and deaths have occurred in children for this reason.
This has happened including after surgery to remove the tonsils or adenoids.
Tramadol should not be given to a child younger than 12 years old.
Triplet: ["tramadol", "has cause", "variation in an enzyme"]

The relation 'has cause' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is caused by or is a result of the factor or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'caused by': The subject condition or symptom is caused by the object condition or factor.
B. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
C. 'occurs if': The condition or event specified by the subject entity happens under the condition described in the object entity.
D. 'has risk factor': The subject condition or event is associated with an increased risk of the factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
